from PIL import Image, ImageFilter
import numpy as np
im=Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L')
a=np.array(im).astype(float)
# large median-ish background via blur
bg=np.array(im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(25))).astype(float)
diff=bg-a  # positive = darker than surroundings
print('diff stats', diff.min(), diff.max(), diff.mean(), diff.std())
# normalize
d=diff.copy()
p=np.percentile(d,99.5)
d=np.clip(d/p,0,1)
# build overlay
rgb=np.stack([a,a,a],axis=-1).astype(float)
mask=d>0.5
rgb[...,0]=np.where(mask, np.minimum(255,rgb[...,0]+d*255), rgb[...,0])
rgb[...,1]=np.where(mask, rgb[...,1]*(1-d*0.5), rgb[...,1])
rgb[...,2]=np.where(mask, rgb[...,2]*(1-d*0.5), rgb[...,2])
out=Image.fromarray(np.clip(rgb,0,255).astype('uint8'))
out.resize((1600,846)).save('/tmp/overlay.png')
print('saved')
"", "description": "Dark-focal overlay heatmap"}
